hypothesis: Alpha Core (50% momentum rank + 50% Bollinger %B rank) contains predictive information that survives realistic trading: it orders future returns at the horizon it is actually traded at, that ordering beats structurally-matched null models, and the resulting book clears its own transaction costs under T+1 execution with price-limit queues.
notes: FINAL ADJUDICATION of the Alpha Core family. Registered BEFORE any Phase 2-10 number is computed, against a state frozen and verified in backtest_output/research_manifest.json. The declared traded horizon is h=20 sessions, because that is the rebalance interval the production system used; h=1/5/10 are measured for the decay curve and CANNOT pass gate 3. Reporting the horizon with the best IC would be a multiple comparison presented as a finding, which is the specific error this platform exists to prevent. Prior evidence (E13/E14/E15) suggests this will FAIL. That expectation is recorded here so that a pass would be the surprising outcome requiring scrutiny, not the assumed one.
expected_failure: G3: mean IC at h=20 below 0.02, or ICIR below 0.30 -- E13 measured 0.01456 and 0.113 on clean data
G6: the strategy does not beat exposure- and turnover-matched random ranking -- E11 measured the 3.3rd percentile
G7: the per-period edge does not clear the 1.04% round trip -- E13 measured 0.55% against 1.04% at h=1
G9: realized exposure falls far short of target -- E3 measured 29.22% against 54.79%
the predictive information is concentrated in names that are limit-locked and therefore unbuyable at t+1 -- E14 measured a 3.03x queue exposure ratio

acceptance_criteria.overall: ALL eleven mandatory gates must PASS. A single failed mandatory gate prevents any 'ready' conclusion, and no gate may be waived, re-weighted or re-thresholded after a number exists.
acceptance_criteria.outcome_A: all gates pass -> proceed to controlled paper trading
acceptance_criteria.outcome_B: any mandatory gate fails on a measured number -> no robust edge
acceptance_criteria.outcome_C: a gate cannot be evaluated because the evidence does not exist -> inconclusive, and the missing evidence is named

parameters.clean_window_justification: research_factors.py fitted Alpha Core's two factors on 2024-09-01..2026-06-30 (17,695 observations over 23 dates). That block is contaminated for factor selection and is NOT a holdout. E5 stopped an experiment over exactly this.
parameters.split_justification: Sequential, by date, fixed here before any number exists. Roughly 70/15/15 of the clean window. The holdout is spendable ONCE and is recorded in windows_touched.
parameters.benchmark: cross-sectional mean of the eligible universe on each decision date

validation_gates.G1_data_integrity: PIT integrity proven: no forward column used as a feature, no forward return exceeding what the price band permits over its horizon, every row inside the declared window, and a restorable universe snapshot cited
validation_gates.G2_reproducibility: the result regenerates exactly from (git commit, code hash, config hash, dataset fingerprint, universe snapshot, seed)
validation_gates.G3_predictive_edge: mean cross-sectional IC at h=20 >= 0.02 AND ICIR >= 0.30 AND >= 55% of decision dates positive
validation_gates.G4_out_of_sample: IC on the untouched holdout > 0 AND degradation from in-sample <= 0.50 of the in-sample level
validation_gates.G5_walk_forward: >= 60% of sequential out-of-fold blocks have positive IC at h=20
validation_gates.G6_null_tests: the strategy reaches >= the 95th percentile of EVERY structurally-matched null distribution, not merely the unconstrained one
validation_gates.G7_execution_realism: net per-period excess after turnover x round trip, with unbuyable slots left in cash and not refilled, is > 0
validation_gates.G8_cost_robustness: G7 still holds at round_trip x 1.25 and with 0.10% slippage charged on each leg
validation_gates.G9_exposure: realized exposure is within 10 percentage points of target, OR the entire gap is decomposed and attributed
validation_gates.G10_drawdown_risk: maximum drawdown <= 35% and the strategy is not dependent on a single regime
validation_gates.G11_research_integrity: no undisclosed post-hoc selection: the horizon, split, thresholds and null models are exactly those recorded here
